summary: Ascentage Pharma Group International filed a Form 6-K on May 12, 2026, furnishing a press release about management participating in three upcoming investor conferences (B. Riley, Stifel, Jefferies). The filing is purely a routine announcement of investor relations events with no special-situation corporate action such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or tender offer. There are no deal terms, board recommendations, or strategic changes disclosed. This is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, not a special situation.
